eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Reasoning AI in Future Communication Systems (ICRFCS 2027) aims to explore and present the integration of reasoning-driven Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies with next-generation communication systems. ICRFCS 2027 focuses on presenting the role of AI reasoning (deductive, inductive, abductive, analogical and fuzzy) in enabling intelligent decision-making, adaptive problem solving and autonomous operations. By addressing the emerging challenges in 5G/6G Networks, Internet of Things (IoT), edge computing, cybersecurity, healthcare, robotics and conversational AI, this conference aims to foster innovation and collaboration in shaping the future of intelligent communication systems.
